screens.tabs: The tab bar at the bottom of every main screen
screens.home: Home, for a manager or administrator
screens.pending: Today — unplanned visits waiting to sync
screens.sync: The sync line on Today and Day end, and the sign-out warning
screens.tracking: The live location line on Today and Me
screens.day: Banners about the day and the time zone, on several screens
screens.remedy: What to do when the server refuses something, on many screens
screens.visit: The visit screen: one visit from arriving to leaving — check in, check out, the recording bar, and the actions during and after the visit
screens.adverse: Flag a possible side effect (adverse event), opened from a visit. The guidance about what the report is and what must not be written stays in English and is not in this file

tabs.me.note: Tab label, under an icon. The rep's own page

common.clearField.note: Spoken by a screen reader; {field} is the field's label

settings.inUse.note: A small badge on the language in use

settings.languageWaiting.note: {language} is Hindi or Marathi, in English; {done} and {total} are numbers

sync.waitingNoSignal.note: One line on a narrow strip; {count} is a number

sync.unreadableMeta.note: Small text at the end of the sync line

today.startVisit.note: Main button; {doctor} is the doctor's name

today.continueVisit.note: Main button; {doctor} is the doctor's name

today.seeRoute.note: A small link at the corner of a card; keep the › at the end

dayEnd.title.note: Screen title; {day} is the word for Today

tracking.lastRefused.note: {reason} is one of the tracking.refused… sentences

remedy.figures.note: {figures} is technical text from the server, left as it is

home.teamDetail.note: Placeholder row; FE-W6 is an internal reference, keep it

home.adminDetail.note: Placeholder row; FE-W6 is an internal reference, keep it

visit.thisVisit.note: Stands in for the doctor's name as the heading when it is not known

visit.checkInAction.note: Main button. Keep the dash: what the rep says, then what pressing does

visit.checkOutAction.note: Main button. Keep the dash: what the rep says, then what pressing does

visit.findingPosition.note: Main button while the phone reads its position

visit.fixUnavailable.note: {reason} is a sentence from the phone, sometimes in English from the phone's own system

visit.checkInApproximate.note: One plain line under the check-in time (decision BE-C5). Must say nothing about consequences — no manager, no review, no pay

visit.checkInOutside.note: One plain line under the check-in time (decision BE-C5). Must say nothing about consequences — no manager, no review, no pay

visit.checkedIn.note: {time} is a clock time such as 11:56

visit.checkedInAndOut.note: {checkedIn} and {checkedOut} are clock times such as 11:56

visit.stageDuring.note: The server has confirmed the check-in

visit.stageDuringPending.note: This phone recorded the check-in and the server has not confirmed it. Must not read as confirmed

visit.stageAfterPending.note: This phone recorded the check-out and the server has not confirmed it. Must not read as confirmed

visit.stepCheckIn.note: A small step badge, one of four in a row

visit.stepWithDoctor.note: A small step badge, one of four in a row

visit.stepCheckOut.note: A small step badge, one of four in a row

visit.stepReport.note: A small step badge, one of four in a row

visit.stepDone.note: A finished step badge. {step} is one of the visit.step… words; keep the ✓

visit.progress.note: Spoken by a screen reader for the row of step badges

visit.unplanned.note: A small badge: the rep made this visit without a plan

visit.directions.note: Small button: opens the phone's maps app at the clinic

visit.withTheDoctor.note: Lower case, after a duration such as 17 min

visit.consentDeclined.note: The doctor said no to recording. An ordinary outcome, not a failure — no warning tone

visit.consentAgreed.note: Does not say he or she: the app does not know the doctor's gender

visit.recordingAgreedAt.note: On the recording bar. {time} is the clock time the doctor agreed, such as 11:58

visit.recordingWithElapsed.note: Spoken by a screen reader. {state} is one of the visit.recording… words; {elapsed} is like 02:41

visit.recordingPausedBecause.note: {reason} is why it paused, such as 'a call came in'

visit.recordingRefused.note: {message} is the server's reason, left as it is

visit.notSaved.note: NOT is in capitals for emphasis: nothing was kept on the phone

visit.doctorSaidNo.note: Must not blame or pressure anyone; the visit carries on

visit.doctorWithdrew.note: Not the same as 'said no': the doctor agreed first

adverse.title.note: Screen title. A rep flags what they heard; they do not assess it

adverse.writeFirst.note: Under the disabled Send button: why it cannot be pressed

adverse.sent.note: Banner title: the server has the flag

adverse.saved.note: Banner title: kept on the phone, NOT yet sent. Must not read as sent

adverse.notSaved.note: NOT is in capitals for emphasis: nothing was kept on the phone
